translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Nongamea'an ni Yesus
Na tempo iya'a, Kaisar Agustus men montomundo'i Batomundo'anna Roma, nomosuu' kada' muntulis ka' mansaa' giigii' mianna.
Nuntulisan ka' nansaa'an kobiai'na mian iya'a nilimang tempo i Kirenius Gubernuur na Siria.
Giigii' mian uga' nomae'mo na kotana sanda-sanda' kada' tulison a ngaanna bo saa'on.
Koiya'a uga' i Yusuf ringkat na kota Nazaret, na libutan Galilea, mae' na libutan Yudea, na kota Betlehem men nongamea'an ni Tomundo' Daud, gause i ia tonsoop lee' ni Daud.
Yusuf nonsoopkonmo ngaanna rua' ira tii Maria men ndoloina bo saa'on. Tempo iya'a i Maria mampaiwawamo.
Sarataa i raaya'a na Betlehem, notakamo a tempona i Maria mindompu.
Ia nangamea'konmo sa'angu' anak moro'one, anakna men balaki'na. Anak iya'a ia pokalimbutimo tia toik ka' nipotokol na pamakaanan ayop, gause raaya'a sian nantausi laigan bo torumpakanna.
Malaa'ikat nangawawa lele bona pontondong domba
Na sa'angu' dodongoan men karani' dodongoan iya'a, isian toropii pontondong domba men mandagai lulusanna domba na padang tempo malom.
Ola-olan taka a malaa'ikatna Tumpu kere-kerer karani' i raaya'a ka' ruarna Tumpu dingkalapan nunguruari i raaya'a, ka' i raaya'a nolayaonmo tuu'.
Kasee malaa'ikat iya'a norobu taena, “Alia i kuu layaon. Mbali' i yaku' notaka ka'ita mase mambantilkon na ko'omuu lele pore men kobeles tuu' bona mian na giigii' lipu'.
Ilio kani'i na kota ni Daud nongamea'mo a men bo Pansalamatkon i kuu, men i Kristus, Tumpu.
Koi kani'imari a bo oosanmuu: Kuu bo mungurumpaki sa'angu' anak ngamea' men nipokalimbuti tia toik ka' nipotokol na pamakaanan ayop.”
Ola-olan ia piile' i raaya'a a malaa'ikat iya'a nobiai'mo a samba-sambana men muntunde' Alaata'ala taena,

content.text: ka' bi pooka'amat a mian na tano' balaki' kani'i men kokana'na Tumpu.”

content: Noko daa iya'a, giigii' malaa'ikat nomae'mo mule'kon na surugaa. Pontotobo' domba iya'a nopootunduniimo simbaya'na taena, “Mai kita mae' na Betlehem mimiile' upa men nosida iya'a, koi men ia bantilkon Tumpu na ko'onta'.”
Raaya'a lako-lako nomae' ka' nuntuungi i Maria tii Yusuf ka' anak ngamea' men nipotokol na pamakaanan ayop.
Sarataa nimiile' anak ngamea' iya'a, raaya'a nuntundunmo tundunanna malaa'ikat men nambantilkon anak ngamea' iya'a na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Giigii' i raaya'a nosamba' nongorongor tundunanna pontondong domba iya'a.
Kasee i Maria tongko' nongoos na noana lele men ia rongor iya'a ka' ningintoomkon pore-pore.

Pontotobo' domba iya'a nomule'konmo na dodongoanna. Ka' banta-bantang mule'kon, raaya'a muntunde' ka' mompopobalaki' Alaata'ala gause giigii' men ia piile' ka' ia rongor i raaya'a, sintuutuu' tia upa men ia bantilkon malaa'ikat na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Yesus nisunat ka' nitarai ngaan
Walu'mo ilio a nongamea'anna Anak iya'a, Ia nisunatmo ka' ia ngaani i raaya'a i Yesus, ngaan men ia bantilkon malaa'ikat bo Ko'ona men koo'po tia ia pintipu'unkon sina-Na.
Yesus niwawa na Yerusalem na Laiganna Alaata'ala
Takamo tempona i Yusuf tii Maria mongoloe'i waka koi aturanna ukum Torat ni Musa. Raaya'a nangawawamo i Yesus mae' na Yerusalem bo rookonon na Tumpu,
gause isian nitulis na kitap ukumna Tumpu koi kani'imari: “Giigii' anak moro'one men balaki'na tiodaa rookonon bona Tumpu.”
Raaya'a uga' nomae' nangatorkon kurbaan koi men taena ukumna Tumpu, men sapaar sapu' sapatau kabai se' rua' sapu' marampatii.

Na tempo iya'a isian sa'angu' mian na Yerusalem men ngaanna i Simeon. Ia mian men kana' a wawauna, malolo' na Tumpu, ka' kuasana Alus Molinas uga' isian na ko'ona. Ia mempeperai tempona Alaata'ala mansalamatkon Israel.
Alus Molinas nambantilkonmo na ko'ona se' i ia sianpo lapus kalu sianpo mimiile' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon men ia toonkon Tumpu.

Gause pingkira'na Alus Molinas, mbaka' i Simeon ninsoopmo na Laiganna Alaata'ala. Na tempo iya'a uga' i Yusuf tii Maria ninsoopmo nangawawa i Yesus men dauga' ngamea' mongololoikon adat koi men nipisiso'konmo na ukum Torat.
Simeon nangalamo Anak iya'a ka' nantaawan, kasi nuntunde' Tumpu Alaata'ala taena,

content.text: Patalaimo a ata'-Muu kani'i lapus pore-pore.
Gause matangku suungku nimiile'mo Pansalamatkon men Kuu takakon.
Pansalamatkon iya'a Kuu poko toropotikonmo bona giigii' lipu'.
Iamo a Ruar men bo pompopo'inti'ikon Alaata'ala na lipu' sambana
ka' men bo pinsidakon lipu'-Muu Israel angga'ion.”

content: Tama tia sina ni Yesus samba' nongorongor giigii' upa men ia porobukon i Simeon muntundun Anakna i raaya'a.

Simeon nambarakaatimo i raaya'a ka' nambantilkon ni Maria taena, “Imamat ini'imari! Anak kani'i ia patukmo Alaata'ala bo pinsilaka'i ka' uga' bo pansalamatkon mian biai' na Israel. Ia sida bookoi oosna Alaata'ala, ka' bo minsidakon poogagaianna mian biai'.
Mbaka' ka'inti'ianmo a isiina noana mian biai'. Siongo' men bo surioon ni'imarian somo koi piso' mungusuk suloowom.”
Indo'o isian sa'angu' nabii wiwine men boroki'mo tuu', ngaanna i Hana. Ia anak ni Fanuel men bense' ni Asyer. Tongko' pitu' taun a nosuo'anna ka' nopoololo'anna tia langkai'na,
ia nobalumo ka' umurna walumpulo'mo papaat taun. Ia tongko' dongo-dongo na Laiganna Alaata'ala, ka' ilio malom tongko' bakitumpu, ba'apata ka' basambayang.
Na tempo iya'a i Hana uga' notaka na ko'ona i raaya'a ka' nobasukuur na Alaata'ala, kasi ia nuntundunkon Anak iya'a na giigii' mian men mempeperai kotakaanna Tumpu mansalamatkon Yerusalem.
Yusuf tii Maria mule'kon na Nazaret
Noko daa i Yusuf tii Maria ningilimang upa men tiodaa limangon koi taena ukumna Tumpu, raaya'a nomule'konmo na dodongoanna na kota Nazaret, na libutan Galilea.
Anak iya'a no'uminsurmo ka' kaekae' motikol. Ia pande tuu' ka' kolingu'na Alaata'ala.
Yesus na Laiganna Alaata'ala
Sanda' taun tama tia sina ni Yesus mae' na Yerusalem mangaramekon ramean Paska.
Na tempo umur ni Yesus sompulo'mo rua' taun, raaya'a nomae'mo na Yerusalem koi men doodoopo wawauonna i raaya'a sanda' taun.
Noko daa ramean Paska, raaya'a nomule'konmo. Kasee sian ia inti'i tama-Na tia sina-Na se' i Ia dauga' nintitako' na Yerusalem.

Raaya'a mongooskon se' i Ia isian nopoololo' tia mian biai'. Sangiliosi a nomae'anna i raaya'a, kasi i raaya'a nansarak i Ia too daa nomae' poololo' tia poto'utusanna kabai se' poo'inti'ianna i raaya'a.
Kasee sian ia tausi i raaya'a. Mbaka' i raaya'a nomule'konmo soosoodo na Yerusalem mae' mansarak i Yesus.
Sarataa tolungilio kasi ia tausi i raaya'a na lalomna Laiganna Alaata'ala. Ia oru-oruang na tanga'na guru agama Yahudi. Ia momorongori i raaya'a batundun ka' uga' bapikirawar na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Giigii' mian men nomorongor i Ia nosida samba' gause i Ia pande tuu' minsimbati.
Minti'i-Napo samba' nimiile' i Ia. Mbaka' sina-Na norobumo na Ko'ona taena, “Anakku, nongko'upa i Koo se' mangawawau koi kani'i na ko'omai? Tamaam tii yaku' noleapkonmo i Koo!”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Nongko'upa mbali' i kuu muntuus i Yaku'? Too sian kuu inti'i se' Yaku' tiodaa ka'ita na Laiganna Tamang-Ku?”
Kasee i raaya'a sian ninginti'i patukna wurung ni Yesus.

Noko daa iya'a ai Yesus nomule'konmo poololo' tii raaya'a mae' na Nazaret. Ia dauga' dongo-dongo na tama tia sina-Na ka' malolo' na ko'ona i raaya'a. Sina-Na nongoosmo na noana giigii' upa men ia piile' iya'a.
Yesus kaekae' uminsur, kapandean-Na uga' kaekae' kanturangan, ka' kaekae' balaki' a polingu'na Alaata'ala tia mian na Ko'ona.
